{"body":"# Input validation and rate limiting for the REST API

Implements #866.

## Server

**Request body validation** (`server/src/components/utils/request_validation.ts`, new):
- All auth request bodies are validated with [zod](https://zod.dev) schemas before any database access; invalid bodies get a `400` with the first validation error as message (`GenericResponse` format, handled by the website's `ApiError`):
  - `POST /api/auth/register`: username (3-20 chars, trimmed), email (valid format, max 60), password (8-40 chars, at least one letter and one digit), `starterDeck` validated against the available starter decks (numeric strings accepted for older deployed clients), `newsletter` (boolean)
  - `POST /api/auth/login`: presence and size checks only for identifier/password, so accounts with legacy passwords keep working (the identifier may be a username or an email)
  - `PUT /api/auth/password` and `PUT /api/auth/password/:id`: password strength rule
  - `POST /api/auth/email`: email format
- The bounds mirror the website forms and the `credentials` table columns, so oversized values now yield a clean 400 instead of a database 500.

**Rate limiting** (`server/src/components/utils/rate_limiter.ts`, new):
- [express-rate-limit](https://express-rate-limit.mikelb.dev) IP-based limiters on the unauthenticated auth endpoints, each responding with a 429 `GenericResponse` and standard `RateLimit-*` headers:
  - `POST /api/auth/login`: 10 requests / 15 min (brute-force protection)
  - `DELETE /api/auth/password/:user`: 5 requests / hour (password-reset mail flooding)
  - `GET /api/auth/exists`: 60 requests / min (user enumeration; the register form's debounced availability checks stay well below it, and a 429 degrades gracefully there)
  - `POST /api/auth/register`: 10 requests / hour (mass account creation and activation mail flooding)
- `app.set('trust proxy', 'loopback')` in `app.ts` so the limiters bucket by the real client IP behind the local reverse proxy, while direct clients cannot spoof `X-Forwarded-For`.

**Refactor**: `sendStatus` moved from `rest_api.ts` to `utils/api_response.ts` (unchanged behavior, now shared with the rate limiter; 429 added to the status texts).

## Website (consistency with the new server rules)

- New shared `passwordStrength` validator mirrors the server's password rule in the register, profile and reset-password forms, so weak passwords are rejected client-side with a German error message instead of an unexplained server 400.
- The starter deck select now binds numeric option values (`[value]="0"`), so registrations send the `starterDeck` as number per the shared `AuthRegisterRequest` interface (the server still accepts numeric strings from older clients).

## Tests

- `request_validation.test.ts`: schema acceptance/rejection matrix incl. starter deck range, password strength and `validateBody` 400 behavior
- `rate_limiter.test.ts`: limit pass/block, per-IP isolation, window expiry and standard headers
- `rest_api.test.ts`: endpoint tests for 400s without database access, registration with the parsed body, and 429s after the login/password-reset limits
- Website: new spec for `passwordStrength`, weak-password cases added to the three page specs

All checks pass from the repo root (`npm run check`: format, lint, tests for server, client and website).

Closes #866
